results.remarks: Privacy, space, and effortless desert living come together in this special Ironwood Country Club residence. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of South Palm Desert's most desirable communities, this light-filled 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers an unusually private setting--you can enjoy the home and outdoor space without looking directly at neighboring residences.The thoughtfully designed floor plan lives almost like 2 PRIMARY suites, giving each bedroom a sense of separation, comfort, and privacy--ideal for hosting guests or enjoying extended stays. The main primary suite is especially generous, featuring two large closets, while abundant storage throughout the home makes it easy to keep everything organized. Natural light fills the interiors, complemented by fresh paint and updated carpeting for a bright, clean feel that's ready to enjoy now or personalize over time.Another standout feature is the exceptionally large garage. Far more spacious than a typical two-car garage, it comfortably accommodates two small vehicles plus a golf cart, with additional room for storage--an incredible asset for the country club lifestyle. A newer HVAC system and updated driveway add to the home's everyday comfort and convenience.Outside, an oversized and remarkably private patio becomes an extension of the living space, surrounded by beautiful desert landscaping and mountain views. With virtually no neighboring homes in sight, it feels like your own secluded retreat. Enjoy quiet mornings with coffee, dinner under the desert sky, entertaining friends, or simply relaxing as the surrounding mountains take on their sunset glow.Set against the foothills of the Santa Rosa Mountains, Ironwood Country Club is a private, member-owned community offering TWO 18-hole golf courses, TENNIS and PICKLEBALL,  a state-of-the-art wellness center, SPA services, DINING, social activities, and an active calendar of clubs and events.Whether envisioned as a full-time home, seasonal escape, or an opportunity to create your ideal Palm Desert retreat, this residence offers a combination that can be difficult to find: exceptional privacy, two spacious bedroom suites, abundant storage, incredible natural light, a huge garage, generous outdoor living, and a peaceful cul-de-sac location in the heart of Ironwood.

With extensive indoor and outdoor improvements already completed, this home is ready for its next owner to move in and enjoy. The living space flows effortlessly through the dining area & sliding door to a large private back patio, while a smaller enclosed patio at the front provides a quiet secondary outdoor retreat. In addition, there is a prepaid dining credit of $816 per year for the community's on-site restaurant, which is separate from and in addition to the HOA dues.

results.remarks:
Welcome to 40621 Terraza, an exceptional desert retreat offering the perfect blend of privacy and resort-style living in the heart of Palm Desert. This expansive residence features approximately 2,718 square feet of living space with 5 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, thoughtfully designed for everyday comfort and entertaining.

Upon arrival, you are greeted by an inviting courtyard entrance that sets the tone for the peaceful atmosphere found throughout the home. Inside, generous living spaces are enhanced by soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a functional open-concept floor plan.

The backyard is truly an entertainer's dream, offering a private resort-style setting complete with a sparkling pool, relaxing jacuzzi, and impressive in-ground BBQ area, creating the perfect atmosphere for sunny pool days and evening gatherings. Surrounded by breathtaking mountain views, this outdoor oasis feels like your own private vacation destination.

Adding to the home's versatility is a private primary suite featuring its own separate entrance through the entry courtyard, ideal for multigenerational living or a private retreat. The property also offers a spacious three-car garage and extended driveway, providing ample room for multiple vehicles, guests, or recreational toys.

Situated in one of Palm Desert's most desirable locations, residents enjoy convenient access to the renowned El Paseo Shopping District, often referred to as the "Rodeo Drive of the Desert," featuring luxury shopping, fine dining, art galleries, and vibrant nightlife. Nearby attractions include The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens, premier golf courses, trails, and Palm Desert Civic Center Park.

Palm Desert and the greater Coachella Valley continue to experience significant growth and revitalization. One of the most exciting developments nearby is Cotino, the first-ever Storyliving by Disney community in neighboring Rancho Mirage. This highly anticipated master-planned community will feature luxury residences centered around a crystal lagoon, along with new dining, shopping, entertainment, and recreational experiences expected to further elevate the desirability of the surrounding desert communities.

Whether you are searching for a primary residence, vacation home, or investment opportunity, 40621 Terraza presents a rare opportunity to own a slice of desert paradise near one of Southern California's most exciting emerging luxury destinations.

results.remarks: Sun. City Palm Desert - Your ''English Garden'' with beautiful Indoor-Outdoor Living!  Welcome to this beautifully appointed 2 bedroom 2 bath home PLUS DEN of approx 1600 square feet, where timeless style meets comfortable desert living. From the moment you enter the inviting gated courtyard with pavers, you will appreciate the homes exceptional curb appeal and thoughtful design. French doors from the courtyard open to the secondary bedroom, creating a welcoming and private entry experience for a guest, or perhaps an office location. Inside, the open and airy  great room floor plan is enhanced by beautiful travertine flooring laid in a classic Versailles pattern. Plantation shutters, crown molding and thoughtfully chosen finishes add a comfortable character. French doors from the great room open  to the rear patio, bringing the lovely landscaped outdoors into the heart of the home. The backyard is truly a private oasis, with professionally landscaped to provide an English Garden feel, featuring colorful flowers, graceful vines and lush greenery. The low maintenance artificial grass and complete privacy create an ideal setting for morning coffee, entertaining friends or simply relaxing in your own tranquil space. Photos are available to show its real beauty when ''in season'' and not as it is now  in our summer months. The open area includes an entertainment center to accompany a   65 ''TV.  The open kitchen area   offers neutral corian counters with white cabinetry and a convenient pantry.  The spacious primary suite offers its own access to the rear patio while the primary bath features dual sinks, a walk in shower and a custom-designed closet. The secondary bath includes a tub/shower combo just across the hall from the secondary bedroom.  The den includes a beautiful king sized murphy bed! And still room for an office/desk area!   There is also a laundry room between the kitchen  and the garage.  BOTH THE AC AND WATER HEATER have been replaced!  This is a home that combines class, privacy and effortless indoor-outdoor living - a special property that is sure to make you feel at home the moment you arrive.  You will have a safe, securely gated community with 2 golf courses, pro shops, driving range, pitching and chipping practice areas and an 18 hole putting course. The ''best deal''that HOA dues provide you are: 3 clubhouses, 2 fitness centers, 5 swimming pools, tennis courts, pickleball courts, bocce ball, and a softball field.

results.remarks:
Indulge in the epitome of Palm Desert luxury living with this breathtaking 3BR/2BA detached home. Nestled within the secure gates of Desert Breezes, this private oasis offers an array of exclusive amenities. The property boasts a Private Pool, Jacuzzi, cascading waterfall, outdoor BBQ island, and a captivating outdoor fireplace, all within the serene backdrop of a meticulously landscaped, oversized lot.

Strategically located just steps away from the renowned Indian Wells Tennis Garden, this residence combines the charm of a gated community with proximity to world-class entertainment. Immaculately maintained both inside and out, this ultra-private haven is designed for seamless entertainment and relaxation.

Step into tastefully appointed interiors, flooded with natural light, and featuring a gas log fireplace in the living room. The formal dining room offers a picturesque view of the pool and waterfall, creating an elegant setting for hosting guests. The kitchen has undergone a complete transformation, showcasing exquisite soft-close cabinetry, pull-out storage units, quartz countertops, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances.

The expansive living room opens to a charming flagstone and grass yard. The jewel of this residence is its vast and lush yard, providing ample space for outdoor activities, poolside lounging, and barbecues. Every detail of this desert oasis has been meticulously crafted, from the variety of mature palm trees to the custom pool featuring a waterfall made from petrified wood.

The Master suite is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring a spacious walk-in closet, a Roman soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a sliding glass door leading to the spa, perfect for a serene nighttime plunge. The secondary bedrooms, thoughtfully situated for privacy, share a beautifully remodeled bath.

Convenience is key with a two-car garage offering direct access to the home. Enjoy the perks of a LOW HOA, with neighborhood pools and spas heated during the winter, along with a recently remodeled community clubhouse featuring a state-of-the-art exercise facility and tennis courts with breathtaking views of the Santa Rosa mountains.

This gem of a property, available furnished or unfurnished, has everything you desire and is sure to be in high demand. Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience this luxurious lifestyle firsthand – contact Denise for a private showing.

results.remarks: The Desert Lifestyle. At Your Doorstep. Set against the Santa Rosa Mountains in South Palm Desert's coveted Ironwood Country Club community, this spacious Garden Villa offers something increasingly hard to find: a flexible 3-bedroom, 3-bath floor plan designed for gathering together while still giving everyone their own space.With 1,853 sq. ft., the home lives generously. A convenient main-floor bedroom offers flexibility for guests, extended family or everyday living, while two private en-suite bedrooms upstairs create comfortable, separate retreats--an especially appealing layout for multigenerational living, visiting family and friends, or a second home where everyone has room to stay. An upstairs nook with mountain views provides the perfect spot for a desk or quiet workspace, without giving up a bedroom to create a home office.Light-filled living spaces capture beautiful mountain views, and the community pool is just steps away--making it easy to settle into the relaxed indoor-outdoor lifestyle Palm Desert is known for. Indoor laundry adds everyday convenience. Lovingly maintained by its longtime owners as a cherished desert retreat, the home is ready to enjoy now or offers the opportunity to update over time and create your own vision.Located within the private, gated Ironwood Country Club community in the Santa Rosa foothills, you're just minutes from El Paseo's renowned shopping and dining, The Living Desert, hiking and all that South Palm Desert has to offer. Whether you're searching for a seasonal escape, a gathering place for family and friends, an investment opportunity, or you're ready to make the desert your year-round home, this is a property that can evolve with the way you live.The HOA allows short-term rentals, subject to its rules, regulations and governing documents, adding another layer of flexibility for second-home ownership. Ironwood Country Club membership is separate, is not included with the property, and is not required for homeownership.Seller can accommodate a quick close. Property is offered as-is, with no seller repairs or cosmetic credits.Buyer and Buyer's agent to independently verify all information, including square footage, room count, HOA rules and approvals, rental requirements and restrictions, and Ironwood Country Club membership terms.

results.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully upgraded Forest Hills model, tucked behind and to the left of the 13th tee box in a truly unique location within Palm Desert Resort Country Club. From here, you enjoy beautiful views of the 13th and 14th holes along with Mt. San Jacinto views. The home also features an attached 2-car garage, extended patio with wall enclosure, and electric retractable awnings at both the living room and primary patio. The floor plan is one of the home's standout features, with two spacious en-suite bedrooms positioned on opposite sides of the home. Each bedroom has its own private bath, giving you the flexibility to use either as the primary suite while providing excellent privacy for owners and guests. Both bathrooms have been refreshed, and the washer and dryer are conveniently located inside the unit in their own dedicated space. The home has been thoughtfully updated with upgraded windows and sliders, wood-look ceramic flooring throughout, a newer water heater, upgraded A/C, and fresh paint throughout, including the garage. The private back patio offers multiple sitting areas and is a wonderful place to enjoy your morning coffee, dine outdoors, or unwind at the end of the day. The extended patio and retractable awnings make the outdoor space especially comfortable and usable. Palm Desert Resort Country Club offers an active resort lifestyle with a beautiful clubhouse featuring formal dining, a lounge, and pro shop, along with 20 pools and spas, tennis, Coachella Valley's premier pickleball club, and an award-winning 18-hole golf course. With its hard-to-find golf course location, extensive updates, flexible two-suite floor plan, and 2-car garage, this Forest Hills model offers a lot of what buyers are looking for in a Palm Desert Resort Country Club home and represents an exceptional value.

results.remarks: Welcome to your private desert retreat, where resort-style living meets modern elegance. This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo is perfectly positioned within the gates of Chaparral Country Club, one of Palm Desert's most sought-after golf course communities.Step through the front door into a light-filled, open-concept living space with soaring pitched ceilings that create a bright, airy ambiance. Just off the entry, a stunning central atrium fills the heart of the home with natural light, offering a tranquil and sophisticated focal point.The fully remodeled kitchen features sleek stainless steel appliances, modern finishes, and a custom bartop that opens to the living and dining areas, perfect for casual meals or entertaining guests.Enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine on the north-facing covered patio, where peaceful views of the 8th hole, a picturesque par 3 over water, provide a daily backdrop of beauty and serenity. With consistent shade and panoramic fairway vistas, outdoor living has never felt more relaxing.Inside, elegant tile flows throughout the main living areas, while plush carpeting adds warmth and comfort to each bedroom. The spacious primary suite is thoughtfully located at the end of the hall for ultimate privacy and includes a generous walk-in closet and a spa-like ensuite with dual vanities, a glass-enclosed shower, and a luxurious jetted soaking tub. The guest bedrooms offer built-in storage, mirrored closets, and one features private atrium access and its own ensuite, ideal for visitors or a home office setup.This home also comes equipped with owned solar, offering both energy efficiency and long-term savings.Tucked away from busy roads yet just a short stroll from the clubhouse and one of the community's 21 pools and spas, this home delivers the ultimate balance of peace and accessibility. results.remarks:
Welcome to “The Palms Retreat,” where desert tranquility meets effortless resort-style living. Tucked away in the coveted Silver Spur Ranch community, this spacious Spanish-style property sits on an oversized 0.26-acre corner lot in a quiet cul-de-sac and features a rare private 1-bedroom, 1-bath casita.

Inside, the home offers a warm, inviting atmosphere with an easy indoor-outdoor flow and plenty of space to gather, relax, and entertain. The private casita is a standout feature, complete with its own entrance, en-suite bathroom, and separate living and dining areas—perfect for visiting guests, extended family, or a private retreat.

Step outside and discover your own desert oasis. The fully fenced backyard features a sparkling pool and hot tub, covered patio, mature citrus, fig, and date trees, and plenty of room to enjoy Palm Desert’s year-round sunshine. With underground utilities, no streetlights, and a peaceful cul-de-sac setting, evenings here are meant for unwinding beneath star-filled desert skies.

Beyond the property, enjoy easy access to Art Smith Trail, the Cross Hike, world-class golf, The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens, and the shopping and dining of El Paseo. “The Palms Retreat” offers the ideal combination of privacy, space, guest accommodations, and the best of Palm Desert living.
